# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{id}/reactions

Remove a reaction from a comment of an issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-302`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `api.EditReactionOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `content` | string | True |  |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — locked issue without write permission
- **404** — comment not found or belongs to different repo

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Comment must belong to the same repository | validation | comment.Issue.RepoID != ctx.Repo.Repository.ID |
| Cannot add/remove reaction on locked issue without write permission | authorization | comment.Issue.IsLocked && !ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWriteIssuesOrPulls(comment.Issue.IsPull) |

### Error Paths

- **comment not found** → changeIssueCommentReaction → 404
- **comment belongs to different repo** → changeIssueCommentReaction → 404
- **issue locked and no write permission** → changeIssueCommentReaction → 403
